label: Magicshine Controls
description: Control supported Magicshine lights from the Karoo app or the in-ride field, with lamp selection, quick beam switching, and battery and temperature telemetry.
releaseNotes:
* Expands the ride field to light, five-second flash, battery, and app segments
* Restores the previous OFF, steady, SOS, or continuous flash state after five seconds
* Adds compact icons to every ride-field segment
